content:
Piper: Hey team — thinking of doing a 'Battle Bunker' LAN next Wed. Bring any modded consoles/romhacks or weird controllers. Pizza + prizes? :pizza:
Noah: Hell yes. I'll bring the CRT and my modded N64 with analog hack.
Juno: I'll bring a couple of retro PC builds for emulation + a USB hub. What time?
Samir: 6pm? Also suggest a tiny 'weird controller' competition. Winner gets a sticker.
Cass: 6pm works. I can bring a hot-sauce-free pizza option (allergic). Also can do polls for game list.
Piper: Cool — sandwich pizza and one veg/vegan box. Can people RSVP by EOD Monday? I'll post a sheet.
Noah: For games: GoldenEye 007, Mario Kart 64, Bomberman, and a 'weird controller' round using Rock Band drums.
Juno: If we run GoldenEye, let's set odd rules: 2-minute rounds, random weapons only.
Samir: Also: can we keep one table for 'cozy co-op' (Overcooked/Heave Ho) for folks who don't want competitive chaos?
Cass: Yes. Also logistics: need extension cords, surge protector, and adhesive velcro for cables. I can bring a power strip.
Piper: I'll assign workspace zones on arrival. Also would love to test a latency comparison between the CRT and a cheap HDMI scaler.
event-bot: Event created: "Battle Bunker LAN + Mod Night" Wed 18:00 — mezzanine. RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/battle-bunker-lan
Noah: :thumbsup: I'll tape up a small sign for the door and bring thumb grips.
Juno: I'll post the signup sheet and a short poll in this thread for 'must-play' vs 'open-play'.
Samir: Last thing — cash-for-pizza or potluck? Vote CASH/POTLUCK in replies.
Cass: CASH
Piper: CASH
Noah: POTLUCK (I make a mean garlic bread)
Juno: CASH (easier)
Samir: Majority CASH, noted. I'll Venmo a headcount after RSVP close.
Piper: Awesome. See y'all next Wed :rocket:
